summary.text: The story follows Urza as he travels the planes seeking weapons to destroy the dark forces that stalk him, beginning at the Tolarian Academy on Tolaria, which he founded with Barrin.

There Urza made the golem-probe Karn to survive time travel, but when Karn used the time machine to save Jhoira, it failed catastrophically, destroying the Academy and leaving Tolaria a shattered temporal landscape.
Urza went on to fight Phyrexia's agents, losing Xantcha and Ratepe in the Sacrifice at Koilos, and resolved to lead the war against Phyrexia rather than merely react to it.
